title: Epstein files latest: photos appear to show former prince Andrew crouching over female
summary: Elon Musk and former UK ambassador to US Peter Mandelson among those named in newly released documents An apparent FBI document released among the US government’s files on Epstein appeared to show a mugshot of Ghislaine Maxwell at the time of her arrest in 2020. It is thought to be the first time this image has been released publicly. Continue reading...
